specs.Low Blue Light: Coocaa's low blue light technology minimizes eye fatigue, providing a soothing, comfortable viewing experience for all.

specs.Frameless Design: The frameless design brings sophistication to your living room without depriving you of space for an even larger screen area for indulgent viewing.
specs.CC Cast: Beam your phone screen instantly with CC Cast. No cord, no delay—just tap, connect, and view your favorite shows on the big screen in less than one second.
specs.Endless Entertainment: Find a variety of free content with more than 300 channels of movies, sports, news, and more—no subscription required. Plug it in and enjoy.
